announcements.title: Newcomer’s Lunch | THIS Sunday! | Lecture Room
announcements.description: For those who are new, or new-ish, join us for a “Newcomer’s Lunch” to learn more about CPC and to meet some of our leadership teams. Lunch will be provided in the Lecture Room for you, just head there! Please fill out a Welcome Card from the pew and return it to the Welcome Bar in the foyer.

announcements.title: Interested in Joining the Body of Christ at CPC?
announcements.description:
We consider the church an essential element of the gospel, so joining CPC as a member is a way to truly join the body of Christ, in all its blessings and with all its flaws! Before joining, you’ll meet one-on-one with a pastor and then discuss how you’ve come to know Christ with the Shepherd Leaders. Contact Alexis Vano (admin@cpcnewhaven.org) to begin the process.
NOTE THE DATE CHANGE: Our next joining will take place on Sunday, November 15.

announcements.title: CPC Worship Night | Friday, October 23 from 7-8pm
announcements.description: Join our music team for an evening of musical worship. We’ll sing some familiar songs and new songs too! We’d love for anybody to join.

announcements.title: Mom’s Discipleship Group | Wednesday, October 14 @9:45am
announcements.description: Please join us! CPC Moms discipleship group meets monthly on Wednesdays in the Fellowship Hall at 9:45am. Children are welcome to play near us while we meet. We will discuss selected podcasts from Ruth Chou Simons, a gifted writer of over 10 books, artist, mother of 6, podcaster, and founder of GraceLaced. Future dates: 11/11, no Dec, 1/13/27. Please inquire with any young mom, or Meg Bogue (mhbogue@me.com) or Kristen Jensen (kristin.jensen358@gmail.com) with questions.

announcements.title: Fall Festival | October 31 from 10:30am-12:00pm
announcements.description: All children and families are invited to join CPC for Fall Fun and Trunk-or-Treat! Interested in decorating your trunk, hosting an activity, or volunteering at the event? Sign up here!

announcements.title: Life Groups and Discipleship Groups
announcements.description:
Life Groups and Discipleship Groups are our way of doing “church in the small” where we meet throughout Greater New Haven to be engaged in prayer, teaching, fellowship and care.
For information on which Life Group may be a good fit, contact Alexis, admin@cpcnewhaven.org.

announcements.title: Pastor Drop-in Office Hours | Craig, Fridays 7:30-10:30am | Jerry, Wednesdays Noon-3:00pm | Other hours available upon request
announcements.description: Drop in for a casual time of discussion, Q&A, prayer, coffee, tea, really whatever you want to make it! If you have a more private or formal need, you’re always welcome to set up a separate time with Pastor Craig (craig.luekens@cpcnewhaven.org), or Pastor Jerry (jerry.ornelas@cpcnewhaven.org) but this is meant to be a space where anyone can drop in.

announcements.title: Parenting Seminar | Saturday, November 7, 9am-11:30am
announcements.description:
CPC Fellowship Hall | Light Breakfast | Childcare provided.
Young and older/wiser parents are all welcome to attend. We’re hoping for helpful cross-pollination among all stages of parenting. There will be time for discussion, collaboration, and prayer.
